request.query: Every neighborhood of zero contains a closed right interval with positive endpoint

items.name: WithZeroTopology.hasBasis_nhds_zero
items.type: ∀ {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀], (nhds 0).HasBasis (fun γ => γ ≠ 0) Set.Iio

items.name: exists_Icc_mem_subset_of_mem_nhdsGE
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [OrderTopology α] {a : α} {s : Set α},
  s ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ici a) → ∃ b, a ≤ b ∧ Set.Icc a b ∈ nhdsWithin a (Set.Ici a) ∧ Set.Icc a b ⊆ s

items.name: ENNReal.nhds_zero_basis
items.type: (nhds 0).HasBasis (fun a => 0 < a) fun a => Set.Iio a

items.name: NNReal.nhds_zero_basis
items.type: (nhds 0).HasBasis (fun a => 0 < a) fun a => Set.Iio a

items.name: ENNReal.hasBasis_nhds_of_ne_top
items.type: ∀ {x : ENNReal}, x ≠ ⊤ → (nhds x).HasBasis (fun x => 0 < x) fun ε => Set.Icc (x - ε) (x + ε)
